title: MASTERS ATTP 2024: final
body_html:
The final of MASTERS ATTP-2024 brought us emotion, motivation, team spirit and the success of one of the largest communities of honest athletes in Moldova — and, with it, good cheer and great health!

Warm congratulations and best wishes to the winner of the MASTERS ATTP-2024 Cup, Master of Sport, coach and exceptional performance athlete — Veniamin DUBROVIN. He is the one who wrote his name into the historic debut of the MASTERS table tennis series in the Republic of Moldova!!!

ATTP’s main motto is as simple and clear as it is powerful: Only together can we secure a better future for table tennis in the Republic of Moldova!

Thank you to all the sponsors who made this Event possible and who support the development of table tennis through events like this!
